actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Freshly draw a NEW COMPLETE FULL-BODY straight BACK VIEW of the SAME adult woman. Full hair through sock-covered feet, white portrait1024x1536. One coherent newly drawn Japanese lineart+hardCEL illustration, no retouching/pasting/composite/filter.

Reference1 CURRENT BODY BASE BACK is the sole head, identity, body proportions and painting-style authority. Match that SAME back-of-head: silver-white broad clumps, strong continuous cool gray/lavender shadow masses in lower/nape hair, restrained dark navy ink. Preserve the big shadow groupings, DO NOT fragment into extra thin white shards/feathery highlights or short streaks. No bright electric blue outerline, cloudy pale patches, waxy orange/red neck or overrendering. Keep baseline's real white planes and slight intentional transitions.
Reference2 is the CURRENT CLOTHED BODY in its original1024x1536 frame with head intentionally omitted on white reference canvas. It gives ONLY the clothing, socks, pose/body locations. Its blank top is not an invitation to shrink or recenter the figure. Use both same-size full frames to preserve original body scale/pose. Draw the complete head naturally from1, whole picture freshly drawn.

Clothes exactly this layer: WHITE sleeveless high-neck crop top, simple continuous BACK panel with center seam and narrow bottom band. No front chest opening or front chest/clavicle shadows on the back. Top highshoulder seam to middle hem about0.91head-unit, same accepted white-shirt length (backmiddle around484 in original framing); do not turn it shorter or a wide bottom band. RED shorts with two back patch pockets, matching central yoke/waistband, proper rear hip volume, rolled cuffs and existing rise/length. Bare hands/arms with natural BACK orientation, no gloves/wristdevices/gear/jacket/shoes. No thighstrap equipment.
Character-LEFT leg/imageLEFT wears ORANGE thigh-high sock, folded fine rib top, flat orange shaft with few purposeful hard shadows. Character-RIGHT/imageRIGHT wears WHITE short sock, foldedtop fine blue ribs, mostly flatwhite shaft with restrained hard ankle/foot shadows. Both feet remain socked, no shoes. Preserve side-specific sock lengths.
Slim adult body, long legs, accepted waist/hip shape/shoulder width, no shortening legs or widening waist. Natural quiet back/waist with no front navel/collarbone/cleavage lines. Clean stable local colors + closed hard CEL shadows, no new white specks, fragmented gray hair clouds, mosaic/grain, blurry gradients, glossy 3D or painterly layers. Knit/seam lines remain. No text/ruler/watermark.
